title: Introduction and Where You Can Get Help

cues.en: Friends.
cues.zh: 朋友們，

cues.en: Welcome back to the PyTorch Workflow module.
cues.zh: 歡迎回到 PyTorch 工作流程模組。

cues.en: Now let's have a look at what we're going to get into.
cues.zh: 看看接下來要做什麼。

cues.en: So this is a PyTorch workflow and I say a, how cool was that animation?
cues.zh: 這是一個 PyTorch 工作流程，我說「一個」，這動畫多酷，

cues.en: Because it's one of many.
cues.zh: 因為它只是許多種之一。

cues.en: When you get into deep learning machine learning, you'll find that there's a fair few ways to do things.
cues.zh: 接觸深度學習、機器學習後，會發現做事有不少不同方式。

cues.en: But here's the rough outline of what we're going to do.
cues.zh: 但這是接下來的大致輪廓，

cues.en: We're going to get our data ready.
cues.zh: 準備資料，

cues.en: Turn it into tenses, because remember, a tensor can represent almost any kind of data we're going to pick or build or pick a pre-trained model.
cues.zh: 轉成張量，記得張量能表示幾乎任何資料，再建立或挑選模型，或挑預訓練模型，

cues.en: We'll pick a loss function and optimize it.
cues.zh: 選損失函數與最佳化器，

cues.en: Don't worry, if you don't know what they are, we're going to cover this.
cues.zh: 不知道它們是什麼不用擔心，會介紹。

cues.en: We're going to build a training loop, fit the model to make a prediction, so fit the model to the data that we have.
cues.zh: 建立訓練迴圈，擬合模型並預測，也就是把模型擬合到手上的資料，

cues.en: We'll have learn how to evaluate our models.
cues.zh: 學習評估模型，

cues.en: We'll see how we can improve their experimentation.
cues.zh: 看看如何透過實驗改善，

cues.en: And we'll save and reload our train model.
cues.zh: 再儲存、重新載入訓練好的模型。

cues.en: So if you wanted to export your model from a notebook and use it somewhere else, this is what you want to be doing.
cues.zh: 如果想從筆記本匯出模型，到其他地方使用，就要這樣做。

cues.en: So where can you get help?
cues.zh: 哪裡能取得幫助？

cues.en: Probably the most important thing is to follow along with the code.
cues.zh: 最重要的，大概是跟著寫程式，

cues.en: We'll be coding all of this together.
cues.zh: 我們會一起寫這一切。

cues.en: Remember motto number one If in doubt, run the code.
cues.zh: 記住第一個口訣，有疑問就執行程式碼，

cues.en: Try it for yourself.
cues.zh: 自己試試。

cues.en: That's how that's how I learn best is I write code, I try it, I get it wrong.
cues.zh: 這就是我最有效的學習方式，寫程式、試試、出錯，

cues.en: I try again and keep going till I get it right.
cues.zh: 再試，不斷繼續，直到做對。

cues.en: Read the docstring because that's going to show you some documentation documentation about the functions that we're using.
cues.zh: 閱讀說明字串，因為會顯示所用函式的一些文件。

cues.en: So on a mac you can use shift command in space in Google CoLab or if you're on a Windows PC, it might be control here.
cues.zh: 在 Mac 的 Colab，可以用 Shift+Command+空白鍵；Windows 電腦，這裡可能換成 Ctrl。

cues.en: If you're still stuck, try searching for it.
cues.zh: 仍卡住，就試著搜尋，

cues.en: You'll probably come across resources such as StackOverflow or the PyTorch documentation.
cues.zh: 大概會找到 Stack Overflow 或 PyTorch 文件等資源。
